name: Martie Jainrose
summary: In Lakeshire, Martie Jainrose tends her garden beside Lake Everstill. She gathers herbs and flowers for the town, though wild beasts threaten her plots. She seems fond of Guard Parker.

sections.title: A Garden by the Lake
sections.body:
Lakeshire's herbalist, Martie Jainrose, gathers herbs and flowers for the town. Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and local brigands threaten the Redridge Mountains, yet she keeps Lakeshire supplied with fresh herbs and floral arrangements. Wild animals trouble her work, especially Bellygrub, a monstrous boar that often ravages her garden beds.

Martie also seems fond of Guard Parker. Parker is courting Darcy, who calls Martie a jealous rival.

faq.answer: Martie Jainrose tends herbs in Lakeshire, in the Redridge Mountains. Her garden lies beside Lake Everstill, where she grows plants and prepares remedies for local residents.

faq.q: What trouble does Martie have with the local wildlife?
faq.answer: Bellygrub, a massive and stubborn wild boar, raids Martie's garden. He tramples her plants and eats her herbs before she can harvest them.

faq.q: Who does Martie fancy in Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Martie seems fond of Guard Parker, one of Lakeshire's guards. Parker is courting Darcy. When he sends Darcy a bouquet of Martie's daffodils, he asks that Martie not be told who it is for.

angles.text: As an herbalist traveling through Redridge, you share Martie's care for fragile plants. Wild boars and encroaching enemies threaten them.
As an Alliance traveler, you see Martie's persistence in Lakeshire. Redridge's people keep up ordinary life while Stormwind leaves the town largely to fend for itself.
